title: People free to protest against policies of Cong govts: Priyanka Gandhi on LPST issue

ai.summary: Congress MP Priyanka Gandhi Vadra stated that peaceful protests against government policies are constitutionally protected, emphasizing that police action should only occur if protests become violent or aggressive.

facts.claim: the right to protest is guaranteed under the Constitution
facts.quote: the right to protest is guaranteed under the Constitution

facts.claim: people were free to agitate against the policies of the party-led governments as long as they are peaceful
facts.quote: people were free to agitate against the policies of the party-led governments as long as they are peaceful

facts.claim: police action should only occur if protests become violent or aggressive
facts.quote: police should take action because the protestors must respect the rule of law

ai.background_note: Congress MP Priyanka Gandhi Vadra commented on the LPST rank-holders' protest in Wayanad, Kerala, which has been ongoing for over four months demanding appointments from the LPST rank list before it expires.
